# Wavlake developers

> The Wavlake developer site, for people and their coding agents. It is a shell for now.

Every page here is a placeholder that says coming soon. This site has no guides, API details or event details yet.

## Pages

- [Build on Wavlake](https://dev.wavlake.com/index.md): Docs for an open protocol and signed requests, written for people and the coding agents they work with.
- [Quickstart](https://dev.wavlake.com/quickstart.md): Where a new developer starts.
- [Concepts](https://dev.wavlake.com/concepts.md): The ideas behind the open protocol and signed requests.
- [API reference](https://dev.wavlake.com/api-reference.md): The REST API, call by call.
- [Event reference](https://dev.wavlake.com/event-reference.md): Events on the open protocol.
- [Agents and MCP](https://dev.wavlake.com/agents-and-mcp.md): How a coding agent reads this site.
- [Changelog](https://dev.wavlake.com/changelog.md): What changed on this site.

## Files

- [llms-full.txt](https://dev.wavlake.com/llms-full.txt): Every page, in one file.
- [pages.json](https://dev.wavlake.com/pages.json): Every page and anchor, as data.
- [sitemap.xml](https://dev.wavlake.com/sitemap.xml): Every page address.
